name: Soudal
verdict: Soudal is 100% family owned through the Soudal Group of founder Vic Swerts. Nothing found.
note: Belgian manufacturer of sealants, adhesives and PU foams. Only record found is an EU antitrust (cartel) litigation against Soudal NV (Cases T-201/16 etc., appeal C-734/23 P), which does not count under the method.
